S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
set -e
# the stopped containers first, then the two unused images by name (the CRI removes the image with all its names and its record)
$CRICTL rm $($CRICTL ps -a -q --state exited)
$CRICTL rmi bench64460740.local/job:1 bench64460740.local/unused:1

S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
# an exited container still counts as a user of its image, so the job's image survives
$CRICTL rmi --prune

S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
$CRICTL rm $($CRICTL ps -a -q --state exited)
$CTR images rm bench64460740.local/job:1 bench64460740.local/unused:1

S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
# the images go from the CRI and their blobs are reclaimed, but the finished job's snapshot still sits on the layers of its image
$CRICTL rmi bench64460740.local/job:1 bench64460740.local/unused:1

S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
$CRICTL rm "$($CRICTL ps -a -q --name bench64460740-job)"
$CRICTL rmi --prune

S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
# the reference solution first (the stopped containers, then prune) ...
$CRICTL rm $($CRICTL ps -a -q --state exited)
$CRICTL rmi --prune
# ... and then "free more": the biggest blob left in the content store is the 8 MiB layer that image A is built on
$CTR content ls | awk 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /MB$/ && $2+0 > 8 {print $1}' | xargs -r $CTR content rm

S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
$CRICTL rm -f $($CRICTL ps -a -q)
$CRICTL rmi --prune

S=/run/bench64460740/containerd/containerd.sock
CRICTL="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$S --image-endpoint unix://$S"
CTR="sudo ctr -a $S -n k8s.io"
$CRICTL rm $($CRICTL ps -a -q --state exited)
$CRICTL rmi $($CRICTL images -q) || true
